verdict.rationale: Honeybadger auto-resolves unresolved errors on deploy and reopens them if they reoccur (docs-6, docs-10), and provides deploy-linked diffs and a query for errors since last deploy (docs-7, docs-20), which together give the raw mechanics for regression tracking. However, there's no explicit evidence of a distinct 'regression' alert/notification type that differentiates a reopened (previously-fixed) error from an ordinary new-issue alert to an SRE. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated regression alert channel/notification distinct from new-error alerts, and confirmation that reopening triggers a differently-labeled notification rather than the same generic error alert.
